title: Coherated sheaf derived Hom adjunction for a qcqs pushforward
statement: Let X and Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, and let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image] have right adjoint a [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint], with counit (the sheafy trace) Rf_*a(K)\to K. For L\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) and K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y), composition with this counit induces a natural map in D(\mathcal O_Y), $$Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(L,a(K))\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(Rf_*L,K).$$ After applying the coherator DQ_Y:D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y), this map is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Use naturality of the supplied internal-Hom comparison c. Postcompose with internal Hom of the restricted counit. Functor.map_comp and the counit naturality square identify both composites, proving the first conjunct without using any existence theorem.

For a quasi-coherent test object M, put S=Lf^*M tensor L. Apply [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-qcoh] and [lem-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-qcoh] to make S an object of the full subcategory. Apply [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-projection-mate] to the supplied adjunction p and tensor comparison t, obtaining an invertible map pf:M tensor Rf_*L to Rf_*S.

The proved private helper trace_bijective_of_projection composes five Hom equivalences: inverse pullback adjunction; inverse tensor-Hom adjunction on X; full-subcategory Hom equivalences and inverse restricted adjunction; precomposition with pf; tensor-Hom adjunction on Y. Apply the supplied mate equation hc, tensor-Hom naturality in the second variable, and pullback-adjunction naturality. The restricted-adjunction inverse is Rf_*(alpha) followed by its counit, so the composite equivalence is exactly postcomposition by the sheafy trace.

The proved private helper rightAdjoint_map_isIso_of_bijective transfers these Hom bijections through the supplied coherator adjunction coh by homEquiv_naturality_right. It proves injectivity and surjectivity of each postcomposition map and applies Mathlib isIso_of_yoneda_map_bijective. This gives the second conjunct.
